what: TOOL DEFECT, not a board. The header comment documents SIX detector classes; the code emits FIVE. 'SIBLING OVERLAP' (lines 32-34: two visible siblings intersecting inside a non-auto-layout frame, exempting backing rects) is described in the docblock and never implemented — grep for SIBLING/OVERLAP/backing hits only the comment. So 'zero OUT/TEXTOVER/SQUEEZED/ESCAPES file-wide' is being reported against a sweep that never ran the sixth check. This is the exact shape CLAUDE.md warns about: a green result over a check that does not exist.
node: scripts/figma/render-defects.mjs:32-34 (doc) vs the out.push set (OUT, ESCAPES, SQUEEZED, TEXTOVER, OVERPRINT)
fix: Either implement SIBLING OVERLAP in the container walk beside the OVERPRINT loop, or delete lines 32-34 from the docblock so the documented class list matches what runs. Implementing it is the right call — it is the detector that catches VIS-2-13.

what: TOOL GAP, class-level. OVERPRINT filters both sides to TEXT (line 118: children.filter(c=>c.type==="TEXT")), so it can only ever catch text-on-text. VIS-2-13 on board 306:2161 was a 'Draft preset' PILL (a filled frame/instance) drawn over a TEXT heading — that pair is structurally invisible to OVERPRINT, and invisible to OUT/ESCAPES too because the pill is inside its parent. A badge, chip, swatch or icon landing on a label is the same visual defect as a timestamp landing on a title, and nothing currently detects it.
fix: Widen the intersect loop from TEXT-vs-TEXT to TEXT-vs-any-visible-sibling, keeping the backing-rect exemption already described in the docblock (skip a pair where the non-text node has no text and fully CONTAINS the other — that is a card, not a collision). Partial containment over a TEXT is the defect.

what: NEW UNNAMED CLASS — the residue this pass was sent to find. VIS-2-21 (board 138:153) is a TEXT node whose own fixed height is smaller than the height its characters need: the second line of 'Dragging to canvas - the panel keeps its scroll' is sheared horizontally through the middle of the glyphs. Every existing detector misses it because the node's BOX is entirely inside its parent — only the GLYPHS are clipped. OUT measures against the board, ESCAPES and TEXTOVER measure the node box against the parent, SQUEEZED needs width < fontSize*3.5. All five pass a node that renders as visibly broken text. VIS-2-05 (2474:12093) is the same cause one notch milder: the box did not clip, so the extra line escaped and collided with the link below instead.
fix: Add a CLIPPED detector: for each TEXT with textAutoResize === 'NONE', clone it, set the clone's textAutoResize = 'HEIGHT', read clone.height, remove the clone; flag when clone.height - node.height >= 4. The clone keeps it non-destructive to the original. Same call can emit the required height as the fix value, so fit-text-frames.mjs can consume it directly.
